description: This PHP class models an EmployeeSkill entity for an API, including metadata annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation. It utilizes traits and interfaces for serialization and normalization within the OrangeHRM project, and defines how an EmployeeSkill object is represented externally.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing EmployeeSkill entities within the API framework, providing details like experience years, comments, and associated skill metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSkillModel with an EmployeeSkill entity and configures filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
